Visually verify this GIVEN reference against samples from ONE video. The reference supplies expected labels and visible criteria, not proof that actions occurred. Inspect each timestamped source image. Return exactly one observation for each step ID. Use status observed only with visible supporting evidence; otherwise unknown and explain why. Evidence seconds must be exact labels present in these images. Do not infer absent actions, repair the requested sequence, claim hidden events, or assign confidence scores. Do not calculate order: the server derives it from your cited timestamps. Return ONLY JSON with keys source_sha256 and observations. Each observation has step_id, status (observed or unknown), reason, evidence_seconds (a list; empty allowed for unknown), and uncertainty (a string). Echo this source_sha256: 8ad356691e9312a182d30a02dcffca118dbbc4c6480a4570b41b6ab662502332. Samples are discrete, not uninterrupted motion. Given reference:
